name: Example Team (fictional)

sdlc.current: Product owner describes requests in GitHub issues.
sdlc.desired: Keep GitHub as the source of truth.

sdlc.current: Acceptance criteria are often clarified during review.

sdlc.desired: Use Copilot with an approved plan.
Record targeted red-green and regression evidence.
Provide an evidence-based local review before human publication.

glossary.brief: The product owner's approved acceptance criteria.
glossary.maintainer: The human role permitted to publish and merge PRs.

pains.description: Issues return from review because acceptance criteria differ.
pains.frequency: Several issues per sprint in this fictional example.

success_criteria: Each implementation has an approved brief and observed test evidence.
No PR is published without a maintainer's explicit action.
constraints: Release and operations are outside the chosen workflow.
Never collect credentials in interview records.

facts.statement: Acceptance ambiguity is the selected bottleneck.
facts.evidence: Fictional interview scenario, not real customer data.

assumptions: A repository with a runnable test command will be available at execution time.
unknowns: Authentication and repository access must be checked on the actual customer machine.
